verdict: Paid channels remain paused; setup milestones must close before relaunch.
narrative: No paid spend ran this period, which means zero paid leads came in — this is a setup phase, not a live campaign window. Your Google Business Profile was the only active channel, generating 56 actions (55 direction requests, 1 website click) across 25 active days, though zero calls were recorded despite 110 impressions. Call tracking on the profile is broken or missing, and we are correcting that now so future call volume is captured accurately. Eight foundational milestones — including CRM build completion, payment path verification, and landing pages — are overdue and are the direct blocker to turning paid media back on; those are the current operational priority. Once those are closed, paid campaigns on both Google and Meta are ready to launch and the conversion path will be intact end to end.
